candidates.name: Finding information held by HM Land Registry
verified_facts: HM Land Registry directs users to registered-property information and distinguishes free property summaries from title registers and title plans.
The guidance states title plans show general boundaries.
HM Land Registry notes that it rarely holds specific boundary ownership information and recommends checking the register, title plan and filed deeds for registered boundary details.
semantic_limits: Availability of ownership or boundary-related documents is not evidence of exact boundary coordinates or terrain elevation.

candidates.name: Search for land and property information
verified_facts: The service distinguishes a property summary, title register and title plan.
The title plan contains the property's location and general boundaries.
Online copies are not proof of ownership; an official copy is required when proof is needed.
semantic_limits: Public property-search output is identity and registration context only and cannot substitute an exact HMLR polygon match or LiDAR sample.
